review_evidence: The source is described as a toy ELF parser/validator and contains executable parsing/validation structures for ELF headers, sections, segments, symbols and relocations.

Two of 33 Lean files contain 32 explicit theorem declarations, including Array extraction-length facts, UInt16/UInt32/UInt64 byte round trips, and Nat shift/mod/bitwise identities; the Enum macro also generates val/ofVal inverse theorems.

Those checked generic byte/bit results are unique formal proof content used by the parser and would be lost by retiring the entire source, so FILTER-002 requires retention even though most files are implementation code.
summary: Reviewed ELFSage; retain because the ELF implementation includes unique proved byte/bit arithmetic and round-trip lemmas.
